answer: Locks are written down in garden, expire in onyx, and umber lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 19 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Someone running 58 aliases therefore needs 18 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 4390 identities would post 1512 proofs and burn roughly 20 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
